events.info: Boxing matches and MMA fights consist of three, minute and a half rounds with minute and a half rest periods. Every fighter gets a chance to win money; win or lose! events.info: Tumua - Das' How Tour Venue Doors & Box Office at 6pm, Hall Doors and seating at 7pm. Show begins at 8pm Please note: $62 seating includes cocktail table service! Tickets range from $ 25 - $62 Tumua is a stand-up Comedian, podcaster, and social media personality. Tumua was born and raised on the island of Oahu in Hawaii. Tumua has two new specials out on YouTube now! Strictly Aloha and Talk Story: The Crowd Work Special. You may have also have seen him in Disneys Live Action film Lilo & Stitch. Catch Tumua live at his upcoming 2026 tour, Das How Tour!
